coding.note: ARCH claims: the authors say they ran 'rigorous ablations' and parameter/FLOP-matched comparisons, but they report no numbers, tables or curves, so all four are coded NO. Data disclosure: Zyda-2 component sources and the annealing replay ratio (60/40) and 10% StarCoder for the 7B model are given, but there are no per-component proportions, so this is PARTIAL. Compute is disclosed as days per model plus a cluster of 16 nodes x 8 H100. The harness for Table I and whether comparator scores were rerun or copied are not stated, so both are NR. Seeds are not reported. The 'Llama3.2-8B' entry is named as printed in the paper. NTK-aware RoPE scaling is credited to bloc97, so it is not counted as a rename. Some quotes are taken from the page-2 architecture bullet list, which serves as the contribution list.
